title: Fusion Ignition
description: Deuterium and tritium fuse into helium and a neutron, giving 17.6 MeV, if they are hot enough, dense enough, and held long enough. Unlocks the Tokamak, heavy water, deuterium and tritium breeding.

puzzle.goal: A plasma of n deuterium-tritium pairs per cubic metre reacts at the rate n²/4·σ; each reaction gives an energy E. Write the power P each cubic metre makes.
puzzle.name: Fusion power density
puzzle.ask: Find P in MW/m³ (u = @{u}) for n = @{n} /m³, s = @{s} m³/s (the reactivity near 15 keV) and E = @{E} J (17.6 MeV).
puzzle.method: Half the ions are deuterium and half tritium: n/2 of each, so the rate per volume is (n/2)²⟨σv⟩.
